name: gradients-studio
description: Gradient backgrounds for website heroes, OG images, launch posts and decks. Free previews with no key; exact-size exports with a free API key.

interface.longDescription: Describe a background in plain words and get a designed gradient (grain, pixel and dither finishes, your logo as an overlay) at the exact size your hero, OG image or slide needs. Previews are free with no key.
defaultPrompt: Use $gradient-backgrounds to add a dark, grainy hero background to the landing page, something like Linear.
Use $gradient-backgrounds to make a 1200x630 OG image background in our brand colors.
